text:
Jules: Hey team — Rina's bday is next Thursday! Quick poll: pinata (🎉) or potted plant (🌿)? We have hybrid folks, so need something ship-friendly.
Carlos: Plant for office vibe, but pinata is iconic. :thinking_face:
Priya: Vote: 🎉 pinata
Aisha: 🌿 plant — easier to ship to remote?
people-ops-bot: :bell: Poll started — current tally: pinata 2, plant 1, undecided 0 (updates as people vote).
Jules: Logistics: if pinata, someone needs to store it till office day. If plant, does someone want to handle watering care?
Diego: I can water the plant for a week. also can pick up if we go plant route.
Carlos: If pinata, can we do mini-candy packs for remote folks? Shipable and safe.
Priya: Love that idea. For shipping, budget ~ $25 per remote person. ok?
Jules: Budget is $150. We have 6 remote folks on the list. That fits.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder created: "Buy gift + arrange shipping" scheduled for 1909994000.
Aisha: Also want to do a virtual confetti GIF in the Zoom. @Mike can you add to slide deck?
Mike: Yep will add. Also can set up a 10-min async toast channel at 11:30 for folks in different zones.
Jules: Final call — plant wins 3-2. Plant it is! Will post sign-up for pick-up/shipping now.
Carlos: Thanks! I'll grab a small snake plant from PlantCorner (they wrap well).
Priya: Sending a virtual card today. Link: http://tinyurl.com/rina-card
Jules: Awesome — thanks team :party_parrot:
Aisha: Can we put a note for allergies (no peanuts) on the delivery labels?
Diego: Good call. I'll add "no nuts" to the shipping notes.
Carlos: If anyone wants to chip in for a small extra gift, drop $5 in the birthday fund (Venmo @redwood-bday or DM me).
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread closed (gift and logistics confirmed).
